title: This Unreal App Is Turning Everyday Chores Into Cash: 'Stood In Line...Got Rs 19,000 In Return' | Viral News - News18
text: Sometimes, even the smallest chores test your patience. Picture this: You are standing in the queue at a bank that’s moving at snail’s pace. Or, imagine waiting for your food delivery boy for 20 minutes, who claims to be ‘almost there’. Indeed, it is frustrating and drains your energy faster than you would want. But what if you came across an app that would do these annoying little tasks for you? This possibility might not be a dream anymore. Recently, a Redditor uploaded a post on the platform sharing that one of his friends works part-time at a similar service-based platform. He revealed that the facility would soon be modified into an application. “I just gotta share this because it’s honestly too good to ignore," he admitted, before stating that he also registered himself on the platform to earn extra money. Redditor Reveals Weird But Lucrative Side Hustle According to the Redditor, the kind of errands one has to perform includes standing in a line, picking up deliveries, booking hospital appointments, conducting house inspections, and “basically anything the client needs immediately." He disclosed getting paid a hefty amount once, just by standing in a political rally as the crowd. “I was asked to test a restaurant’s food so the client could attract more customers, and also make an appointment at a dermatologist clinic to write the client’s name and secure their slot, so they wouldn’t have to waste time waiting," added the Reddit user. Doing such odd jobs in small slots after college and full-time on weekends helped him earn Rs 19,000. “If you’re a student or part-time worker from Tamil Nadu or Karnataka, this is a side hustle that actually pays," he wrote. Internet Loves This Odd Part-Time Job The internet jumped into the comments sections in no time. “Not telling the platform name is a crime," pointed out a disappointed user. “This is something really amazing. I really appreciate innovations and ideas which actually create employment for all levels," lauded another. “This company seems like a game changer," noted an individual. Many wanted to sign up on the platform. What are your thoughts on this?
